# AI-data-map

A Taiga-style System-1 executor that builds Quebec Law 25 data-mapping canvases in the browser.

- Repo: https://github.com/movahedi-ca/AI-data-map
- License: MIT
- Status: Phase 0 (freeze and spec) in progress, October 2026

## What it is

Four layers: a chatbot that asks four questions and writes recipes from deterministic
templates (zero LLM tokens in v1), an MCP tool (`execute_mapping_workflow`) that validates
recipes, the mapping-guide canvas and Excel tools, and a tiny custom transformer
(~1.2M params, ONNX, onnxruntime-web) that picks the next action from a versioned
action catalogue.

## Key facts

- Retention values are ranges only, never single numbers, each citing the actual
  statute plus an as-of date. Done-heads emit "verify" flags, never compliance verdicts.
- Every output is a draft inventory for review, not legal advice.
- Everything runs client-side. No server inference, no telemetry, no accounts.
- Training data comes from a scripted Playwright teacher (zero tokens), trained on
  free Kaggle GPUs, published to Hugging Face under MIT.
- Eval targets: 95%+ task success on held-out synthetic orgs, 90%+ length
  generalization, 90%+ unseen vendor combos, 85%+ recovery after injected wrong
  actions, under 5 ms per action in-browser.
